 Item 8.01 Other Events. 
 The shares of our operating subsidiary ACM Research (Shanghai), Inc. (“ACM Shanghai”) are listed on the Sci-Tech innovation board (the “STAR Market”) of the Shanghai Stock Exchange (the “SSE”). In accordance with the SSE’s rules governing the STAR Market, ACM Shanghai filed with the SSE a Record of November 2026 Investor Relations Activity (the “Record”). The SSE posted the Record to the SSE’s website on November 18, 2026. A copy of the Record is attached as Exhibit 99.1 hereto. 
 The information in this Current Report on Form 8-K, including Exhibit 99.1, is intended to be furnished and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that Section, nor shall it be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any filing of ACM Research, Inc. under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.

Records of Investor Relations Activities NO.: 2026-06 Type of investor relation activities □Specific target research □Analyst meeting □Media interview √ Earnings conference call □Press conference □Roadshow □On-site visit □Others Date November 16, 2026 Venue Conference Call Representatives of the listed company Chairman: HUI WANG General Manager: JIAN WANG Chief Financial Officer: LISA YI LU FENG Board Secretary: MINGZHU LUO Summary of investor relations activities I. Company Introduction: Management of ACM Research (Shanghai), Inc. (the “Company”) provided a brief overview of the Company’s third-quarter 2026 results and financial position and answered questions from investors. II. Q&A 1. Q: October saw strong order activity across the industry. What do you expect to see in terms of order trends and growth from November 2026 through 2027? A: Since the second half of this year, we have continued to see healthy order growth. New orders signed for the first three quarters of 2026 were up 147% year over year. As we previously disclosed, our order backlog totaled RMB 17.073 billion as of September 29, 2026, up 88.20% from the order backlog we voluntarily disclosed for the same period last year. We currently have a substantial order backlog and are 
 1617351195.3 Internal working to fulfill and deliver our existing orders. As we typically do, we plan to voluntarily disclose our 2027 revenue outlook in January 2027. 2. Q: Have you experienced any shortages of components and parts? How are procurement costs overall, and have these factors affected delivery lead times for your products? A: We have been monitoring market conditions for components and parts and have built up strategic inventories. We have also taken steps to mitigate the impact of market fluctuations, including sourcing a greater proportion of components and parts locally, diversifying our supply base, and building up inventory in advance. Following an internal restructuring, we reorganized our procurement function into three departments: Strategic Procurement, Development Procurement, and Execution Procurement. Overall, this has helped us control procurement costs. As for delivery lead times, our current lead time is approximately 7 to 8 months, primarily due to our substantial order backlog. Our first Lingang building is already operating near full capacity, while production at our second building began in the fourth quarter of 2026. Once the second building is fully operational, the two buildings together can support annual output of approximately RMB 20 billion. We believe this additional capacity will help us improve delivery efficiency and may further shorten order lead times. 3. Q: Based on the Company's order backlog and fulfillment progress, what should we expect for cleaning revenue in 2026 and 2027? Also, could you walk us through the reasons for the decline in gross margin in the third quarter of 2026 and your gross margin outlook for 2026 and 2027? A: As previously mentioned, our order backlog totaled RMB 17.073 billion as of September 29, 2026, up 88.20% year over year. For 2027, we expect cleaning revenue to maintain steady growth, while its share of the overall revenue mix may decline slightly as revenue from other product lines also increases. We remain fully committed to our long- term target for 60% market share in China's cleaning equipment 
 1617351195.3 Internal market. Our SPM product line is a key part of the target, and we estimate that SPM tools represent about one-third of the total cleaning equipment market. As more customers adopt our SPM products, we believe we are only beginning to see the contribution of this product cycle to our growth, with potential for further growth. In October, we introduced an enhanced version of our 170°C single-wafer high- temperature SPM cleaning system featuring a new sulfuric acid recycle capability. The system achieves a 70% sulfuric acid recycling rate and is expected to reduce SPM consumption by approximately 400 tons per tool annually, helping customers lower chemical consumption and operating costs. We are on track to ship more than 20 single-wafer SPM tools to multiple customers in 2026. Beyond SPM, we continue to expand the capabilities and applications of our other differentiated cleaning technologies. Regarding gross margin, we remain committed to our long-term target range of 42% to 48%. Gross margin can fluctuate from quarter to quarter, primarily due to changes in product mix and temporary effects from exchange rate fluctuations. From a financial reporting perspective, exchange rate movements can reduce the RMB- translated amount of revenue, while material costs remain unchanged because they are paid in RMB. This puts downward pressure on gross margin.

 Item 8.01 Other Events. 
 The shares of our operating subsidiary ACM Research (Shanghai), Inc. (“ACM Shanghai”) are listed on the Sci-Tech innovation board (the “STAR Market”) of the Shanghai Stock Exchange (the “SSE”). In accordance with the SSE’s rules governing the STAR Market, ACM Shanghai filed with the SSE a Record of November 2026 Investor Relations Activity (the “Record”). The SSE posted the Record to the SSE’s website on November 18, 2026. A copy of the Record is attached as Exhibit 99.1 hereto. 
 The information in this Current Report on Form 8-K, including Exhibit 99.1, is intended to be furnished and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that Section, nor shall it be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any filing of ACM Research, Inc. under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.
